rationale: count, max and collect have no expression vocabulary and group_by does not aggregate, so target_disease_pair and disease_label keep a project planner that supplies the SQL body while computed_field only states names and types. Two of the six derived relations therefore depend on SQL for their operation. To close the declared-versus-computed gap the module now refuses to compile unless the SQL aliases match the declared columns exactly and the body states GROUP BY, pinned by three tests; adding aggregate operators to the framework grammar was named as the alternative and left as a kg-build-system proposal.
subject: P-22
title: Aggregations stay a project SQL module; computed fields are witnesses
